_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Notification Hub are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

delivery.emptyReturned: No notifications were returned within this request’s scope.

delivery.receiptsExplanation: A returned receipt records adapter acceptance. It does not establish device arrival or human reading.
delivery.noReceiptSummary: No adapter receipt was returned for this notification.
delivery.noReceipt: No adapter receipt was returned. Reach remains unknown.
delivery.noReceiptCaveat: A missing receipt does not tell you whether the notification was read, the device was offline, or a separate request was answered.
delivery.requestStateSeparate: Ask and history status are separate from delivery receipt evidence.
delivery.unknownStatusExplanation: No delivery success is assumed from this status value.
delivery.reportIssue: Include this notification ID when reporting the issue.
delivery.attemptsUnavailable: Attempt history is not available from the current read contract. No attempt rows are inferred from current status or receipts.

meanings.unknown: The current status value is not recognized.

detail.defaultIn: If you do not answer, {{option}} applies in {{time}}.
